title: DIO time verifier accepts malformed ICMPv6 checksum
description: Post-fix correctness review: DioTimeVerifier checks type/code and parses DIO but never validates the ICMPv6 checksum; current direct envelope/vectors omit IPv6 pseudoheader addresses, making validation undefined. Define the authenticated IPv6/pseudoheader envelope, validate checksum before DIO parsing, and add a re-signed bad-checksum vector/test.
